Protocol evidence fixes Polar construction inputs: reliability sequence, information/frozen/PC sets, CRC/RNTI context and rate recovery. RTL choices such as list size implementation, lazy copy, sorter topology, PM normalization and pipeline cuts
are implementation strategy and must be closed by bit-exact path traces.
